I am an economist working on climate, fiscal policy and finance. I work on carbon pricing policy design, sustainability-linked sovereign lending, and country-level fiscal and climate policy engagements across Europe, Africa and Asia. I hold master's degrees in philosophy, economics and physics.

## Research

The research is in two parts.

[Policy and Finance](policy/index.qmd) has four sections: carbon pricing in open economies; other tax and fiscal policy; finance and risk for clean power; and sovereign incentives for national climate policy. Most papers come with slides and a short policy brief.

[Modelling and Analytics](modelling/index.qmd) outlines analytics tools for climate-fiscal work.

The whole portfolio is summarized in one slide deck, one slide per paper with a divider for each section: [Slides (pdf) →](papers/Slides-ResearchPortfolio.pdf)

My work sits where climate, fiscal and financial policy meet:

- **Effective carbon pricing**: measuring the total effective carbon price across direct and indirect policy instruments
- **Carbon pricing in open economies**: feebates, destination carbon taxes through VAT, and border adjustments
- **Sustainability-linked finance**: the operational architecture of sustainability-linked sovereign lending
